dimensions.label: Functional completeness
dimensions.description: Share of tested acceptance criteria whose held-out checks all pass.

dimensions.label: Business correctness
dimensions.description: Share of executable held-out checks that pass (business rules written independently of the implementer).

dimensions.label: Security
dimensions.description: Held-out checks tagged security (permission holes, secrets, injection).

dimensions.label: Integration
dimensions.description: Held-out checks tagged integration (external contracts, failure behaviour).

dimensions.label: Reliability
dimensions.description: Held-out checks tagged reliability (recovery, concurrency, idempotence).

dimensions.label: Operational readiness
dimensions.description: Held-out checks tagged operational_readiness (deploy, rollback, observability).

dimensions.label: Human rework
dimensions.description: Minutes a person spent fixing the delivery, as recorded by that person.

dimensions.label: Escaped defects
dimensions.description: Defects found after acceptance, as recorded later by a person.

dimensions.label: Cost
dimensions.description: USD the runner reported; never estimated.

dimensions.label: Incorrect-approval rate
dimensions.description: Share of criteria the runner approved whose held-out checks failed.
